```{r setup, include=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, cache=FALSE}
# Load the packages and shared helpers used to identify and plot the olfactory lineage.
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,
  cache = TRUE,
  autodep = TRUE,
  cache.comments = FALSE,
  cache.path = file.path(
    here::here("results", "cache", "publication_pipeline"),
    paste0(tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(knitr::current_input())), "/")
  )
)
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
library(Seurat)
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(SeuratExtend)
})
# Load the analysis functions.
publication_dir <- dirname(normalizePath(knitr::current_input(), winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE))
source(file.path(publication_dir, "publication_helpers.R"), local = TRUE)
```

Find clusters at multiple resolutions
```{r choose_clustering_res}
# Display the clustering results at resolutions 0.3 and 1.0.
resolutions <- c(0.3, 1.0)
for (res in resolutions) {
  filtered_seurat <- FindClusters(
    filtered_seurat,
    resolution = res,
    algorithm = 2
  )

  cluster_col <- paste0("RNA_snn_res.", res)

  p <- DimPlot(
    filtered_seurat,
    group.by = cluster_col,
    reduction = "umap.unintegrated",
    label = TRUE
  )

  print(p)
}
```

Based on marker gene expression, I chose a resolution of 0.3
```{r final_clusters_plot}
# Plot the selected whole-tissue clusters before choosing olfactory-lineage cells.
clusters <- DimPlot(filtered_seurat, 
                    reduction = "umap.unintegrated", 
                    group.by = "RNA_snn_res.0.3", 
                    label = TRUE) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none"  # Removes the legend
  )

# Add axis labels
clusters <- clusters + theme_umap_arrows(x_label = "UMAP_1", y_label = "UMAP_2")
clusters
```

Remove, and Plot removed/retained
```{r select-lineage-clusters}
# Retain the lineage clusters and exclude cluster 15 before reprocessing.
# Define the RNA_snn_res.0.3 clusters, excluding cluster 15 for now.
keep_clusters_0.3 <- c(0,1,2,14,4,3,12,7,16,8,10)  # excluding 15

# Get cells in those clusters directly
cells_0.3 <- WhichCells(filtered_seurat, expression = RNA_snn_res.0.3 %in% keep_clusters_0.3)

# Get the intersection cells of cluster 15 at 0.3 and cluster 31 at 1.0
cells_15_0.3 <- WhichCells(filtered_seurat, expression = RNA_snn_res.0.3 == 15)
cells_31_1 <- WhichCells(filtered_seurat, expression = RNA_snn_res.1 == 31)
cells_15_in_31 <- intersect(cells_15_0.3, cells_31_1)

# Combine all the desired cells
final_cells <- c(cells_0.3, cells_15_in_31)

# Subset the object
filtered_seurat_lineage <- subset(filtered_seurat, cells = final_cells)

filtered_seurat$lineage_selection <- ifelse(
  colnames(filtered_seurat) %in% final_cells,
  "Retained",
  "Removed"
)

lineage_selection_plot <- DimPlot(
  filtered_seurat,
  reduction = "umap.unintegrated",
  group.by = "lineage_selection",
  cols = c("Removed" = "grey85", "Retained" = "#d95f02"),
  shuffle = TRUE
) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_blank(),
    legend.title = element_blank()
  ) +
  theme_umap_arrows(x_label = "UMAP_1", y_label = "UMAP_2")

lineage_selection_plot
```

WHAT IS CLUSTER 12??
Find markers of it
```{r find-first-pass-markers}
# Find first-pass cluster markers so remaining non-lineage groups can be identified.
Idents(filtered_seurat_lineage) <- "RNA_snn_res.0.4"

top_30_cluster_12 <- FindMarkers(
  filtered_seurat_lineage,
  ident.1 = "12",
  only.pos = TRUE,
  min.pct = 0.25,
  logfc.threshold = 0.25
) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
  arrange(desc(avg_log2FC)) %>%
  head(30)

print(top_30_cluster_12)
```

Identify positive markers for each cluster and export the full and filtered marker tables.
```{r find-second-pass-markers}
# Find markers for the final lineage clusters and optionally write their tables.
marker_results <- find_markers(filtered_seurat_lineageb, "RNA_snn_res.0.6")

resolutions <- 0.6 #standin
for (res in resolutions) {
  cluster_col <- paste0("RNA_snn_res.", res)
  marker_results <- marker_results #standin
  res_tag <- gsub("\\.", "", as.character(res))
  write.csv(marker_results$markers,
    file.path(marker_output_dir, paste0("allMarkers_Res", res_tag, "_allcells.csv")),
    row.names = FALSE)
  write.csv(marker_results$top_markers,
    file.path(marker_output_dir, paste0("topMarkers_Res", res_tag, "_allcells.csv")),
    row.names = FALSE)
}
```

```{r prepare-lineage-counts}
# Count cells by sample and cluster before using those counts in the summaries and plots below.
filtered_seurat_lineageb$sample <- factor(
  filtered_seurat_lineageb$sample,
  levels = c("p1", "p3", "p5", "p8", "p15", "p22")
)

# Calculate the total number of cells per sample.
total_cells_per_sample <- filtered_seurat_lineageb@meta.data %>%
  group_by(sample) %>%
  summarise(total_cells = n())

# Calculate counts per cluster and sample.
counts <- filtered_seurat_lineageb@meta.data %>%
  group_by(sample, cluster_name) %>%
  summarise(count = n()) %>%
  ungroup()

# Add the sample totals and calculate each cluster's percentage.
counts <- merge(counts, total_cells_per_sample, by = "sample")
counts <- counts %>%
  group_by(sample, cluster_name) %>%
  mutate(percentage = (count / total_cells) * 100) %>%
  ungroup()
```

Sample by cluster counts
```{r assign-broad-lineage-groups}
# Map final cluster numbers to broad lineage groups.


counts <- counts %>%
  mutate(
    broad_cluster = case_when(
      grepl("mOSN", as.character(cluster_name)) ~ "mOSN",
      grepl("iOSN", as.character(cluster_name)) ~ "iOSN",
      grepl("INP", as.character(cluster_name)) ~ "INP",
      grepl("MV", as.character(cluster_name)) ~ "MV",
      TRUE ~ as.character(cluster_name)
    )
  )

counts_summarized <- counts %>%
  group_by(sample, broad_cluster) %>%
  summarise(
    count = sum(count),
    total_cells = unique(total_cells),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(percent = (count / total_cells) * 100)

wide_counts <- counts_summarized %>%
  select(sample, broad_cluster, percent) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = broad_cluster, values_from = percent)

print(wide_counts)
```

Make colors
```{r plot-broad-lineage-groups}
# Plot broad lineage groups with a fixed order and color palette.
base_colors <- c(
    mOSN = "#e41a1c",      # red
    iOSN = "#377eb8", # blue
    INP = "#4daf4a",    # green
    GBC = "#984ea3",        # purple
    MV = "#ff7f00",    # orange
    Sus = "#ffff33",      # yellow
    HBC = "#a65628",     # brown
    Bowmans = "#f781bf"      # pink
)



# Build group_label and colors
counts <- counts %>%
  mutate(group_label = interaction(broad_cluster, cluster_name, sep = "_"))

group_colors <- c()
for (bc in unique(counts$broad_cluster)) {
  subclusters <- counts %>%
    filter(broad_cluster == bc) %>%
    arrange(cluster_name) %>%
    pull(cluster_name) %>%
    unique()

  n <- length(subclusters)
  shades <- generate_shades(base_colors[[bc]], n)
  names(shades) <- paste(bc, subclusters, sep = "_")
  group_colors <- c(group_colors, shades)
}
my_palette <- group_colors
names(my_palette) <- sub("^[^_]+_", "", names(my_palette))
```

Check that celltype distribution is similar between replicates
```{r summarize-lineage-membership}
# Summarize lineage membership by age for the stacked composition plot.

filtered_seurat_lineageb$sample <- factor(filtered_seurat_lineageb$sample, 
                                           levels = c("p1", "p3", "p5", "p8", "p15", "p22"))

# Step 1: Total cells per seq_folder (replicate)
total_cells_per_replicate <- filtered_seurat_lineageb@meta.data %>%
  group_by(sample, seq_folder) %>%
  summarise(total_cells = n(), .groups = "drop")

# Step 2: Counts per cluster, sample, and seq_folder
counts <- filtered_seurat_lineageb@meta.data %>%
  group_by(sample, seq_folder, cluster_name) %>%
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop")

# Step 3: Merge and calculate percentages
counts <- counts %>%
  left_join(total_cells_per_replicate, by = c("sample", "seq_folder")) %>%
  mutate(percentage = (count / total_cells) * 100)

# Plot the replicate-level lineage percentages.
clust_membership_all <- ggplot(counts, 
                               aes(x = percentage, 
                                   y = seq_folder, 
                                   fill = cluster_name)) +
  geom_bar(stat = 'identity', position = 'stack', color = "darkgrey", size = 0.2) +
  facet_grid(sample ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +  # Vertical facets
  xlab("Percentage (%)") +
  ylab("Replicate") +
  ggtitle("Cluster Composition: Replicates Grouped by Sample") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    strip.text.y = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", angle = 0),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
    legend.position = "right"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(scale = 1)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = my_palette)

print(clust_membership_all)
```


what clusters have what sample in them?
```{r summarize-cluster-composition}
# Summarize final cluster composition by sample for the membership figure.

# Extract cluster assignments
Idents(object = filtered_seurat_lineageb) <- "cluster_name"
cluster_assignments <- Idents(filtered_seurat_lineageb)

# Extract sample information (assuming it's stored in metadata under "sample" column)
samples <- filtered_seurat_lineageb@meta.data$seq_folder

# Create a data frame with cluster assignments and sample information
cluster_sample_df <- data.frame(Cluster = cluster_assignments, Sample = samples)

# Create a contingency table
contingency_table <- table(cluster_sample_df$Cluster, cluster_sample_df$Sample)

# Convert the contingency table to a data frame for easier manipulation
contingency_df <- as.data.frame(contingency_table)

# Check which samples are represented in each cluster
# This creates a list of clusters with the samples they contain
clusters_with_samples <- split(contingency_df, contingency_df$Var1)

# Identify clusters that do not contain all samples
all_samples <- unique(samples)
missing_samples <- lapply(clusters_with_samples, function(cluster_data) {
  present_samples <- cluster_data$Var2[cluster_data$Freq > 0]
  setdiff(all_samples, present_samples)
})

# Print results
for (cluster in names(missing_samples)) {
  if (length(missing_samples[[cluster]]) > 0) {
    cat("Cluster", cluster, "is missing samples:", paste(missing_samples[[cluster]], collapse = ", "), "\n")
  } else {
    cat("Cluster", cluster, "contains all samples.\n")
  }
}
```
